highlights.title: Light theme
highlights.text: The whole interface now follows your system when it is set to light. Dark mode looks exactly as before.

highlights.title: Logs console
highlights.text: Every part of the app in one live console, with each line tagged by source and severity.

highlights.title: Feature discovery
highlights.text: Hints point out Keep-Alive and Click Sync, with a one-time confirmation before any background input.

fixes: The app follows your system light and dark setting reliably.
Turning Keep-Alive off and back on no longer leaves a card missing its controls.
The Launcher's empty-state message no longer gets clipped.
